hooks.name: spec-sync
hooks.description: When the state machine changes, check it still matches its spec and run the tests.

action.prompt: src/lib/state-machine.ts was just changed. Compare the change with the attribute table, events and time decay rules in .kiro/specs/pet-engine/ (requirements.md and design.md). If code and spec disagree, tell me which one is wrong and fix the spec or the code (ask first if unsure). Then run `npm test` and report the real result. Do not claim tests pass without running them.
